purpose: Preregistered paired development evaluation for the single EKF comparator
reuse_rule: Reuse frozen B/C3 rows only after exact provenance checks; rerun all C1 rows and any missing B/C3 scenario-seed keys through the frozen V3 evaluator.
detector_rule: Use the unchanged frozen V3 speed-sensor reliability monitor. EKF is excluded from detector entry logic and supplies feedback only after substitution is requested.
observer_rule: Run the frozen EKF continuously from sample zero using applied voltage and measured armature current; keep nominal EKF motor parameters under parameter variation.
